correctness.rationale: Contraction maps ν_h to ν_(h+1) averaged over m branches; expansion maps ν_h to ν_(h-1) for h>=1 and ν_0 to itself. Stationary reflected birth–death probabilities are (1-r)r^h from detailed balance. For two independent uniform positions in one cell, H(u)=2u-u² for u<=1 and 1 above, hence exactly the finite-sum formula plus geometric tail. Dominated convergence handles mr<1 without any m²r restriction; at mr=1 geometric S_n(mr)=n+1 supplies log term; at mr>1 elementary finite geometric identities give eps^alpha Φ(t) plus precise linear and quadratic remainders. Polynomial versus t^alpha proves Φ nonconstant; compact t phases yield complete subsequential range. Three independent exact rational mixture comparisons were computed for m=2,3,5 including critical/bounded cases.
